recommendation: Keep this audit as-is. Revisit only if the work group explicitly wants the Credits link restored to every generated page footer as a current navigation/design decision.
issue_request: FHIR-11442 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core change request from the DSTU2 ballot asking for a credits link at the bottom of the home page; the accepted resolution was to add it to the footer.
initial_application: Git-svn commit 8b58c09a58 (#11442, svn revision 11398) added an active Credits link to source/newfooter.html. Later commit 057ed2a475 added a Community Credits link directly to source/index.html.
additional_context: The current build-scope home page source/index.html is listed in publish.ini and links to credits.html as Community Credits. The credits page is active in publish.ini and linked from source/documentation.html. The old global footer link was commented out in the generic 2019 footer rebuild commit b953d9bd97 and that commented state was preserved when the template moved to tools/templates/newfooter.html in 2020. Community searches found no later decision requiring the global footer link to be restored.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Re-enabling the commented footer link would be a broad global navigation change, while the current homepage already provides the requested credits navigation.

evidence_items.learned: The current home page still provides the requested credits navigation.
